meaning: Required human attention, not merge authorization or bug probability
green_contract: Whitespace-only method edit, stable signature and resolved calls, complete source-only compilation and flow, no directives, caller-source introspection or unscoped file/declaration changes, no risky changed dependency
model_threshold_status: Prototype threshold, not calibrated on code-review outcomes

rules.boundary: Non-mechanical edits at a base- or head-marked review boundary require human review
rules.signature: Changed public signature, addition or removal requires human review
rules.unknown: Missing compilation, flow, or call resolution cannot receive lighter review
rules.whitespace: Only whitespace trivia changed within the supported compiler contract
rules.behavior: Non-mechanical edits need inspection unless a stronger rule applies
rules.model: Model risk signals can escalate attention, never clear PA warnings
rules.dependency: A green candidate calling a non-green changed method is escalated
